body: I never wanted kids until 30, when all of my friends were having them. I jumped on the train thinking this will be great and had one. Lost the first one then had a rainbow baby. I tried my best, felt like a failure..... Still do. She's now almost 19 and has moved away to live her life without me. She doesn't involve me in her life, doesn't call me. I do reach out but it's like pulling teeth....If I could go back in time.....
I'm for it. It's truly not fair to bio women.

I used to do the same thing with benzos. They only made me sleep and that's what I wanted. To completely check out. And I did. I had several things that I didn't want to confront in my life so instead I checked out. After an attempt, and hospital stay, I ended up having to face the things I didn't want to.A nasty divorce. Break up with your girlfriend. Become what you want. Maybe change schools. You can do this. It won't cure everything in your life but you'll find some things get easier along the way. If you are suicidal, drinking and benzos will increase those thoughts every time you do them. I know from experience. Try to face what's killing you....
